explanation: Macaulay's theorem (the c = 0 case of EGH as stated in Caviglia–De Stefani, arXiv:2007.15467): every homogeneous ideal of k[x_1..x_n] has the same Hilbert function as a lex ideal. hilbertFunction I d = dim_k I_d (equivalent to comparing quotients), IsLexIdeal is a monomial ideal closed upward in lex order (toLex on exponent vectors, x_1 most significant) within each degree. Faithful.
